name: BankrollNetwork
fix_description: In distribute, profit is calculated as share * timeDelta with no cap on timeDelta. After long inactivity, a single deposit triggers massive dividend distribution. Fix by capping timeDelta to distributionInterval, or setting lastPayout = now when no tokens are staked.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is a very short flash-loan-funded logic abuse with only a few external interactions: flash borrow, buy, repeatedly call buyFor with the vulnerable contract as recipient, then sell and withdraw. Although it uses a DeFi primitive (flash loan), the core bug appears straightforward and the PoC is compact and easy for an experienced auditor to reproduce quickly.
